name: 0G Sentinel
description: Provable, drift-aware admission for AI agents on 0G. Identity-bound, versioned admission leases backed by verified 0G Compute, root-matched 0G Storage evidence, and reason-coded AgentGateV2 decisions.
note: Color and font values below are mirrored from the canonical token source for handoff. The running app reads them from tokens.css, never from this file.

logo.concept: A corner-cut seal enclosing a keyhole. The seal frame echoes the dossier clip-path motif used across the evidence cards; its top-right corner is clipped and its base narrows to a sentinel point. The keyhole at the center reads two ways at once: a watchful eye (the sentinel) and a lock (ProofLock). The frame inherits currentColor so the wordmark stays monochrome-friendly; the keyhole carries the single violet accent, so the mark holds up in one flat color and at 22px in the nav.

voice.notes: Lead with what can be proven, not with adjectives. Name the evidence (0G Compute, 0G Storage root, reason-coded gate decision). Never overclaim: if a value is a demo fixture, say so. Sentences over slogans. No exclamation, no hype, no em-dashes. Technical readers over marketing readers.
